impact: Prepared queue/spec and analysis provenance refer to different source revisions. It can misbind later comparisons; no real dispatch/cost or affected real corpus established.

impact: A semantically equal plan becomes a different frozen spec and cannot be re-added to the same queue. Queue correctly prevents conflicting spec binding; no duplicate inference was performed.
